newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - July 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on July 15:
WASHINGTON - The oil industry is in the midst of a merger and consolidation phases at the refineries where gasoline is produced and at the gas stations where it's sold.

NEW YORK - An internal investigation by Texaco Inc. found no evidence that company employees shredded documents requested by plaintiffs in a race discrimination lawsuit or that their superiors knew they discussed destroying and withholding documents, according to a new report.
WASHINGTON - Orbital Sciences Corp. of Dulles announced a deal to pay $37 million in cash and assumption of debt to buy satellite manufacturing and communications divisions of CTA Inc.

WASHINGTON - The Maryland government is begining to rewrite the rules for the state's electricity industry, a process that could enable homeowners and businesses to shop for low-cost power just as they shop for long-distance telephone service.
